translations.seoDescription: OLING provides IT project advisory, enterprise software and compliance consulting, covering governance, ERP and organisational support.
translations.heroTitle: IT project advisory, enterprise software and compliance
translations.heroIntro: Since 2012, OLING has supported public- and private-sector organisations with IT project scoping, regulatory compliance and information systems performance.
translations.heroSideHtml:
IT, business and compliance expertise

OLING designs and manages projects involving ERP, data governance, cybersecurity, GDPR, quality standards (ISO 27001, Qualiopi), business process transformation and business-side IT project management.

Innovation & operational excellence

Our approach combines active monitoring, continuous R&D and innovative tools, including MAPSI, to anticipate regulatory and technological developments and deliver lasting efficiency for our clients.

Performance and budget control

Our services are designed to deliver a rapid return on investment through a modular, tailored and pragmatic approach that fully reflects each organisation’s budget constraints.
translations.bodyHtml:
Our mission

To be a trusted partner for scoping, managing and securing our clients’ IT, regulatory and organisational projects, with practical, well-controlled solutions that comply with the most demanding standards.

Our areas of expertise

IT project advisory, ERP, CRM, CMMS, cybersecurity, GDPR, ISO audits, quality, safety and environment, DORA/NIS2 compliance, data governance, Microsoft 365, hybrid infrastructure, risk management, and business continuity and disaster recovery.

Our approach

A collaborative approach based on listening, close engagement with operational teams, agility and a proven methodology informed by ISO, CNIL, ITIL and DevOps best practices. Our deliverables focus on results and user adoption.

Our commitment to quality

OLING is ISO 27001:2022 certified. Our internal processes are aligned with the strictest quality and security standards to maintain a high level of excellence in every project we deliver.

A certified multidisciplinary team

Certified Data Protection Officers, ISO auditors, IT project advisory managers, systems and cloud engineers, cybersecurity experts and Qualiopi trainers. OLING assigns an agile, qualified team to every engagement.

Join us

Would you like to contribute to IT, compliance and organisational projects that deliver real value to clients? Join OLING, a fast-growing consultancy where you can develop in a stimulating, demanding and supportive environment.

translations.bodyHtml:
Expertise tailored to a wide range of industries

Our cross-industry approach enables us to apply robust, standardised principles while taking account of each sector's specific characteristics and requirements. This allows us to provide our clients with bespoke solutions tailored to their challenges and objectives.

  • Public sector, major ports and airports

  • Wholesale and distribution

  • Water utilities

  • Social housing providers and property developers

  • Vocational training

corePage.intro: OLING works across a wide range of environments with the same commitment: understanding business constraints, clarifying priorities and making transformation programmes manageable.
corePage.title: Industries supported by OLING

sections.text: OLING only presents industries it has genuinely served. For each one, this page highlights recurring constraints encountered during documented engagements and the most common transformation contexts.
sections.title: Practical, industry-specific support

sections.text: In the transport and local government sector, we helped create a service catalogue for a local authority with 2000 employees, streamlined its organisation and implemented ERP systems to improve operational and financial performance at major ports and airports. Our work also included developing IT roadmaps and digitalisation strategies, achieving compliance with ISO standards and the GDPR, and assessing information systems for business continuity.
sections.kicker: Public sector, major ports and airports

sections.text: For wholesale and distribution companies, we draw on our expertise in ERP, CRM, BI, management accounting, purchasing and inventory processes, sales management and finance. We support our clients throughout the application integration process and help them make the most of Office 365 collaboration tools.

For water utilities, we have worked on modernising treatment and distribution infrastructure, optimising water management processes and implementing digital solutions to improve the monitoring and control of water networks.

For social housing providers and property developers, we have helped clients transform their business processes and implement information systems tailored to the sector's specific requirements, including digital solutions that support management and operations.
sections.kicker: Social housing providers and property developers

sections.text: For apprenticeship and training organisations, we have ensured compliance with quality, safety and environment requirements, Qualiopi and the GDPR, deployed online training solutions, skills management tools and collaboration platforms, and supported compliance with applicable quality standards.

filters.label: IT project advisory and business applications

missions.title: CMMS project advisory and field service IT modernisation
missions.context: The organisation needed to modernise field service management and improve the reliability of data exchanges between maintenance operations and its existing systems.
citations: For a public water utility, OLING defined the framework for a CMMS interoperable with its technical, customer, HR and finance systems, as well as its GIS.
The engagement covered the assessment, target architecture, functional requirements framework, tender process, selection, testing and acceptance.
missions.intervention: OLING led the assessment, workshops, target architecture, functional requirements framework, tender process, selection, testing and acceptance.
missions.categoryLabel: IT project advisory and business applications

missions.title: Divalto Infinity ERP project advisory and IT governance
missions.context: The group was undertaking an industrial ERP project combined with business-side project management and IT governance support.
citations: Within an industrial group, OLING provided business-side project management for a Divalto Infinity ERP project and the associated IT governance.
The documented engagement combines ERP project advisory, interim CIO services and PMO support without attributing any unmeasured outcomes to the work.
missions.intervention: OLING supported the implementation of Divalto Infinity through business-side project management, IT governance, interim CIO services and project oversight.
missions.categoryLabel: IT project advisory and business applications

missions.title: Transformation of a public-sector finance system
missions.context: The finance system needed to be put back on track while meeting public-sector budgetary and accounting requirements.
citations: For a major seaport, OLING supported the redesign of a finance system subject to public-sector financial management requirements.
The documented work covered project management, assessment, the strategic roadmap, functional design and data migration preparation.
missions.intervention: OLING handled project management, the assessment, target strategy, functional design and data migration preparation.
missions.categoryLabel: IT project advisory and business applications

missions.title: Project advisory for the e-invoicing reform
missions.context: The organisation needed to prepare for the reform within a heterogeneous IT environment and assess its impact on invoicing flows.
citations: For a transport operator, OLING defined the framework for the e-invoicing reform based on use cases, processes and IT data flows.
The engagement produced a current-state assessment, gap analysis, target architecture and the materials required for the tender process.
missions.intervention: OLING defined the use cases, mapped the processes and data flows, designed the target architecture and prepared the tender process.

missions.title: Outsourced Data Protection Officer and GDPR governance
missions.context: Shared digital services required ongoing GDPR governance and a clearly identified point of accountability.
citations: For an intermunicipal authority, OLING served as the outsourced Data Protection Officer in a shared digital services environment.
The documented engagement focused on GDPR governance and monitoring the organisation's compliance.
missions.intervention: OLING served as the outsourced Data Protection Officer and structured GDPR governance within the organisation's shared services environment.

missions.title: GDPR assessment of customer data processing
missions.context: The organisation needed to assess its customer data processing activities as part of a GDPR compliance review.
citations: For a semi-public company, OLING conducted a GDPR assessment focused on customer data processing.
The documented work covered the analysis of customer data processing activities and the delivery of a GDPR assessment.
missions.intervention: OLING analysed customer data processing activities and conducted the associated GDPR assessment.

missions.title: Outsourced QSEE management and continuous improvement
missions.context: The organisation needed to maintain long-term governance of quality, safety and environmental matters across its port operations.
citations: For a major seaport, OLING provided a documented outsourced QSEE management service over several years.
The engagement covered process reviews, documentation, indicators and action plan monitoring.
missions.intervention: OLING provided outsourced QSEE management covering process reviews, documentation, indicators and action plans.

missions.title: Process management and ISO 14001 transition
missions.context: The organisation was undertaking separate initiatives involving process management and the transition of its environmental management system.
citations: For a major seaport, OLING supported a documented process management initiative as part of an ISO 9001 engagement.
A separate engagement covered the transition of the environmental management system to ISO 14001:2015 and the associated transition plan.
missions.intervention: OLING supported process management, the integration of environmental data and the preparation of the ISO 14001:2015 transition plan.

missions.title: Quality management and Qualiopi monitoring
missions.context: The group required quality leadership and operational monitoring of several Qualiopi requirements.
citations: For a vocational training group, OLING provided a documented outsourced quality management service.
The invoiced work included updating the organisation chart, monitoring Qualiopi indicators 1 to 3 and submitting a DUERP workplace risk assessment document.
missions.intervention: OLING provided outsourced quality management and worked on the organisation, Qualiopi indicators and the DUERP workplace risk assessment document.

missions.title: Quality management and Qualiopi compliance
missions.context: The organisation needed to update its practices and evidence in line with changes to the Qualiopi assessment guide.
citations: For a training provider and apprenticeship training centre, OLING facilitated a workshop on changes to the Qualiopi assessment guide.
The engagement covered the advisory board, success, employment and satisfaction indicators, as well as programme information sheets.
deliverables: Update of success, employment and satisfaction indicators
missions.intervention: OLING facilitated a workshop on the assessment guide, supported the advisory board and reviewed the indicators and programme information sheets.
missions.organization: Training provider and apprenticeship training centre

missions.title: DORA, impact analysis and business continuity planning
missions.context: The organisation needed to structure its digital assets and risks, then formalise its business continuity arrangements.
citations: For a mutual insurance provider, OLING documented ICT assets, their criticality and the risk assessment and treatment procedure as part of a DORA initiative.
An associated business continuity engagement produced an RIA, a BIA and business continuity plan documentation.
missions.intervention: OLING supported the inventory and classification of ICT assets, risk assessment, impact analysis and BCP documentation.

missions.title: IT and telecommunications continuity plan
missions.context: The organisation needed to structure continuity arrangements for its critical infrastructure, systems and applications.
citations: For a major seaport, OLING initiated the PCIT framework covering infrastructure, systems and applications.
The documented engagement included scoping workshops, an IT and telecommunications continuity plan and an initial technical test.
missions.intervention: OLING led the launch, initial workshops, creation of the component register and an initial technical test for the PCIT.
